profile.description: 2026 route prospect for the leg manager. Rides & Rods Classic Car Show runs Sept. 11-13, 2026 at Elko City Park. Official contact remains Stormy Remington, ridesandrods@yahoo.com, 775-385-6569. Current official material promotes cars, live music, food/drink, games, dancing, vendors and entertainment; no current inflatable provider has been verified. Adventure Zone can remain a 2026 possibility if the event has room, with prepaid or pay-for-play both workable last-minute models.

notes.subject: Aug. 27 outreach sent
notes.body: Desiree sent the personalized Rides & Rods outreach to Stormy Remington at ridesandrods@yahoo.com on Aug. 27, 2026. Do not leave the old Aug. 26 email action as overdue. Current official research still confirms Sept. 11-13 at Elko City Park and Stormy at 775-385-6569. Official event material lists games, music, food/drink, dancing and vendors; no current inflatable provider was verified. Give the email a short response window, then call/check back because the event is close.

followUps.label: Call/check Rides & Rods after Aug. 27 email
followUps.reason: Personalized email was sent Aug. 27. If Stormy has not replied by Monday Aug. 31, call 775-385-6569 and ask whether there is room or a need for a full staffed inflatable carnival this year. Keep both prepaid and pay-for-play available because this is last-minute.
